Concrete extraction map for the current 2,490-line [browser-tools.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/browser-tools.ts).

## Recommended layout

```text
web/src/keating/
  browser-tools.ts                 # public facade and assembly only
  browser-tools/
    shared.ts
    prompt.ts
    media.ts
    teaching.ts
    assessment.ts
    improvement.ts
    workspace.ts
```

This should reduce the public file to roughly 100–150 lines without changing tool behavior.

## Exact extraction ranges

| Module | Current ranges | Contents |
|---|---:|---|
| `prompt.ts` | 97–125 | `KEATING_OPERATIONAL_PROTOCOL`, speech prompt, `composeKeatingSystemPrompt`, `KEATING_SYSTEM_PROMPT`, `buildKeatingSystemPrompt`, `getActiveKeatingPrompt` |
| `shared.ts` | 184–223, 447–456 | `createTool`, `executeToolText`, `KeatingToolsOptions`; add shared `OutcomeCollector` and `ToolInvoker` types |
| `media.ts` | 225–427, 631–717, 830–954, 2486–2490 exports | Storyboard/image helpers; `animate`, `generate_image`; preserve all four existing test/public helper exports |
| `teaching.ts` | 718–829, 955–975, 1226–1270, 1506–1571, 1746–1860, 2469–2485 | `deck`, `plan`, `map`, `verify`, `outputs`, `learner_state`, `timeline`, `due`, goal tools; deck slug/card helpers |
| `assessment.ts` | 462–478, 976–1005, 1039–1212, 1572–1745 | real-outcome collector; `bench`, `quiz`, `feedback`, `grade_quiz`, `ask_user_question`, `grade_question_checks` |
| `improvement.ts` | 127–181, 1006–1038, 1213–1225, 1271–1505, 2287–2337 | policy parsing/serialization; `evolve`, `policy`, `auto_improve`, `improve`, `trace`, `prompt_evolve`, `prompt_eval`, `evaluate_teaching`, `request_teaching_improvement` |
| `workspace.ts` | 429–445, 483–630, 1861–2286, 2338–2463 | runtime result helpers; `agent_runtime`, `remote_execute`, NodePod source tools, host project tools, conditional local-exec tools, and the three consolidated workspace tools |
| `browser-tools.ts` | 458–461, 481, 2464–2467 plus imports/re-exports | create outcome collector, build feature groups, create injected invoker, append consolidated adapters and speech tool, return tools |

## Shared API shape

```ts
export type OutcomeCollector =
  () => Promise<BrowserLearnerOutcome[]>;

export type ToolInvoker =
  (name: string, params: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<string>;

export interface KeatingToolsOptions {
  agentRuntime?: KeatingAgentRuntimeConfig;
  speech?: {
    settings: WebSpeechSettings;
    getApiKey: (provider: string) => Promise<string | undefined>;
  };
  setSystemPrompt?: (basePrompt: string) => void;
  getSessionSamples?: () => Promise<BenchSessionSample[]>;
}

export function createTool(...): AgentTool;
export function createToolInvoker(tools: AgentTool[]): ToolInvoker;
```

Recommended factory signatures:

```ts
createMediaTools(storage: KeatingStorage): AgentTool[]
createTeachingTools(storage: KeatingStorage): AgentTool[]

createOutcomeCollector(
  storage: KeatingStorage,
  getSessionSamples?: KeatingToolsOptions["getSessionSamples"],
): OutcomeCollector

createAssessmentTools(
  storage: KeatingStorage,
  collectOutcomes: OutcomeCollector,
): AgentTool[]

createImprovementTools(
  storage: KeatingStorage,
  options: KeatingToolsOptions,
  collectOutcomes: OutcomeCollector,
): AgentTool[]

createImprovementCapabilityTools(
  invoke: ToolInvoker,
): AgentTool[]

createWorkspaceTools(
  options: KeatingToolsOptions,
): AgentTool[]

createWorkspaceCapabilityTools(
  invoke: ToolInvoker,
): AgentTool[]
```

Facade assembly:

```ts
const collectOutcomes = createOutcomeCollector(
  storage,
  options.getSessionSamples,
);

const tools = [
  ...createWorkspaceTools(options),
  ...createMediaTools(storage),
  ...createTeachingTools(storage),
  ...createAssessmentTools(storage, collectOutcomes),
  ...createImprovementTools(storage, options, collectOutcomes),
];

const invoke = createToolInvoker(tools);

tools.push(
  ...createImprovementCapabilityTools(invoke),
  ...createWorkspaceCapabilityTools(invoke),
);

if (options.speech?.settings.enabled) {
  tools.push(createSpeechTool(...));
}

return tools;
```

## Module dependencies

- `prompt.ts`: persona, learner-context, raw prompt Markdown, storage type.
- `media.ts`: storage, `resolveTopic`, provider models/proxy, image generators, UI settings, shared `createTool`.
- `teaching.ts`: storage, `resolveTopic`, SRS validation/state, goals, engagement timeline functions/types, shared `createTool`.
- `assessment.ts`: storage, learner-outcome extractors, benchmark functions, quiz functions/types, shared `createTool`.
- `improvement.ts`: storage/Policy, benchmark and evolution functions, prompt evolution, proposal functions, `nodePodCreateSnapshot`, `getActiveKeatingPrompt`, shared types/helpers.
- `workspace.ts`: agent runtime type, NodePod runtime operations, shared tool builder/invoker.
- Facade: only feature factories, speech, storage, and shared types.

## Circular-import hazards

1. `evaluate_teaching` and `request_teaching_improvement` currently search the mutable `tools` array for legacy tools. They must receive an injected `ToolInvoker`; `improvement.ts` must never import the facade.

2. `workspace_inspect`, `workspace_exec`, and `workspace_change` have the same dependency on the assembled registry. Construct them only after all base workspace tools have been added.

3. The real-outcome collector is used by both assessment and improvement. Export it from `assessment.ts`, then inject its callback into both factories. Improvement should not import assessment tool factories.

4. `getActiveKeatingPrompt` belongs in `prompt.ts`; improvement imports it directly. `prompt.ts` must not import improvement.

5. No feature module should import `../browser-tools`. All imports flow toward `shared.ts`, `prompt.ts`, core/storage, or runtime modules.

6. Keep `createSpeechTool` in the facade so voice remains appended once and only when enabled.

## Compatibility requirements

Keep these exports available from `browser-tools.ts` through re-exports:

```ts
createKeatingTools
KeatingToolsOptions
KEATING_OPERATIONAL_PROTOCOL
KEATING_SYSTEM_PROMPT
composeKeatingSystemPrompt
buildKeatingSystemPrompt
getActiveKeatingPrompt
parseStoryboardScenes
__test_buildHyperframesComposition
__test_parseStoryboardDurationSeconds
__test_storyboardTitle
```

The existing tests and `useKeatingAgent.tsx` import the facade, so no callers need changing.

I would also preserve the existing tool-name order during this structural-only refactor. Tool ordering can influence model behavior even though capability selection is name-based. A small ordering helper or explicit name-order array in the facade is safer than silently regrouping schemas.

Unused imports that can be dropped during the move:

- `evolvePolicy`
- `_evolvePolicyLegacy`
- `BenchmarkResult`
- `EvolutionRun`
- `ImprovementProposal`
- `nodePodApplyEdits`
- `nodePodRollbackEdits`
- `clearPreEditSnapshots`
- `nodePodInfo`

Finally, the NodePod generator recursively includes `web/src/keating`, so the new nested directory is supported. Regenerate `nodepod-boot-files.ts` after extraction. No files were changed in this analysis.

I’m implementing this as a behavior-preserving extraction: the facade will explicitly restore the existing schema order after collecting feature factories, while consolidated adapters receive an injected registry instead of importing the facade.
